# GrayNest

> GrayNest is a software house in Palestine. Senior engineers build web and
> mobile products, backends and internal tools for startups and businesses,
> with AI integrated only where it pays off. Not related to Gray Nest, the
> vintage market in Illinois (graynest.com).

## What we build
- Web apps and iOS and Android apps
- Backend systems, APIs, data models, integrations and payments
- Internal tools: dashboards, back offices and workflows
- AI integration inside products: search, assistants and automation

## How we work
- Plan first: problem, users and constraints written down; system design reviewed before build
- Ship phase one in weeks, then decide phase two from real usage
- Five phases: discovery, architecture, build, ship, maintain

## Free app teardown
- A recorded 15-minute review of a small business's app or website by
  GrayNest's CTO, with a written summary of three fixes ranked by impact
- Covers usability, page speed, unanswered customer questions, visible
  security issues where they apply, and where AI could save work
- Free, with no commitment and no sales pitch; five reviews a month
- Delivered on WhatsApp within 48 hours of receiving the link

## Team experience
- Individually, GrayNest's engineers have built software for Nokia, Red Hat,
  and more than 10 startups, new and established. These were not GrayNest
  projects
